outcome: medical termination of pregnancy (MTP) in 1st trimester
medical termination of pregnancy (MTP) in 2nd trimester
infant living with mother and biological father
cohort: The study included 105 unmarried women selected by convenience sampling method in the Department of Obstetrics and Gynaecology at a Tertiary Care Hospital in Central India.
finding: The study found that a significant proportion of unmarried pregnant women underwent medical termination of pregnancy (MTP), and among those with live births, outcomes varied from infants dying, being given to orphanages, or living with parents/biological father, with only some women marrying the biological father.
mod_finding: Among the 24 live births, 17 were full-term vaginal deliveries, 6 were preterm vaginal deliveries, and 1 case underwent lower segment cesarian section.
cross-section timing: Data was collected among women presenting at a tertiary care hospital, covering their demographic characteristics, experiences during pregnancy (MTPs), and immediate outcomes around the time of delivery or MTP.
